name: Kanda Kanna
source:
A new member of the student council led by Tomohiro. 
Her quality of having a blunt personality is refreshing for the existing members, so direct that she sometimes freezes the entire student council. 
Even so, she's really attentive to small details, and has the strength to survive even in an athletic organization.

[From the [url=https://madosoft.net/totsu/sub_character]official website[/url]]

She appears on Hiyori's route only
